core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss Brutalism with Nike-style Athletics.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'fast' and 'competitive'.
Content is King: Data (scores, times, prices) should look like stats on a scoreboard.
Contrast: Neon accents against deep void backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'colors' and 'fontFamily' defined above. Extend the theme, do not overwrite.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the 'noise' texture to the body in index.css.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, manually override the rounded classes to match 'rounded-sm' for buttons and 'rounded-2xl' for cards.
5. DATA-TESTID: Every interactive element (Button, Input, Select) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').
6. MOBILE FIRST: Always design for 375px width first. Use 'hidden md:block' for desktop-only elements.
7. NO GRADIENT TEXT: Do not use gradient text on buttons. Use solid high-contrast colors.
8. USE SONNER: For all notifications, use the 'sonner' library.
9. AVOID DEFAULT SCROLLBAR: Customize the scrollbar to be thin and dark (zinc-800).
universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Unbounded'.
Do not use purple or teal for CTAs. Use Neon Lime (#CCFF00).
Always add 'hover:text-black' when hovering over a primary button.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. 'p-8' is the new 'p-4'.
Never center everything. Asymmetry creates tension.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.
